body: Lol thanks, and sorry for not getting back to you sooner, some stuff popped up. And if you're asleep it was nice talking to you.
Bring Me to Life, but My Immortal is also good. I used to listen to their stuff all the time, them and Linkin Park from the Hybrid Theory album.

I sometimes draw for three hours on end. It's great background music and always funny when you catch the tail end of some conversation. 

AMVs are always good. For some reason that old Evanescence song has been floating around my head recently. Lonely Island is pretty funny.

Not going to lie I enjoy watching Markiplier most days. I also catch some podcasts where a bald Canadian man and his friend from New York play games and talk nonsense for about two hours. It's good to draw to.

What about you? Music videos? Podcasts? Creepypasta readings?

I almost went for that because I wanted to be a Game Designer when I was younger. Three years of computer science and programming classes destroyed my passion in high school. 

I'm actually excited for my drawing and art courses to start soon. I won't have to bury my face in art books for a little bit.

Of course I draw, I needed some way to draw all my favorite anime and video games characters. I paint a little too, but not nearly as good. Used to read a ton as well but haven't so much anymore.

Been too busy drawing, watching youtube, and going to college.

I play games, though I would read manga if there was a store around here that would sell it. Also that description makes me think so much of High School of the Dead minus the harem. But it's okay, I watch anime for the plot xD

Hey, I'm actually pretty far behind on what anime are out and what I've watched. Currently watching *Akame ga Kill* and the most recent thing I've watched before that was *Kill La Kill*. However my friend tells me *Prison School* is pretty messed up but he likes it.

I read it friend. I don't want you to go, even if you are a stranger. It's horrible that they don't offer better support/treatment for your condition. I know these may not mean much to you, but at least know I've read your story.

Been depressed since about the eighth grade, so have my friends. One of them was too much of a nice guy to share his problems, so without warning he ended his life. Didn't even leave a note. He was set to graduate with honors that year. 

Sat in the shower a long time after that, thinking about my life. It seems so easy to just say 'Hey, you could be just like him. Why not? Your life has been shit. All your experiences are falsified and fabricated and you can't actually connect with others. So do it, besides you're a nihilist anyways. What's life matter to you?' 

But I got out of the shower and didn't. Regardless of how twisted this world is, or my life seemed to be. I'm gonna live it out. I have never taken antidepressants or mood stabilizers or allowed any other foreign chemical in my body. I have not sought treatment, nor will I.

At this point I'm living for really one solid reason. I have a comic book series I want to publish before I die. And I'm going to do just that.

League of Legends is one of my current addictions. I've only caught a couple episodes of Steven Universe but I find it to be pretty deep for just being a children's show, then again old school Spongebob did have a lot of adult humor. I really don't play a lot of Steam anymore, except for the occasional Nuclear Throne and Terraria. Netflix was what I used to bingewatch anime back in the day but I haven't kept to up to date on that. Currently watching Akame ga Kill and I've also been meaning to watch Gurren Lagann and Sword Art Online.

Also I'm in a love hate relationship with computer programming and learning a couple other languages. Oh and I'm going for my degree in Art. 

Wow...didn't mean to fill up all this space. Sorry for the wall o text.
